visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a close-up, eye-level shot of two black snack bags branded with the red Netflix logo, specifically 'Caramel Popcorn,' sitting on a light-colored wooden table. A person's hand briefly enters from the top right, and in the background, a large TV screen displays a scene from a film. (2) A hand holds up four different Netflix-branded snack bags in front of the TV, which is now displaying the static red Netflix logo on a black background. The camera is static, and the lighting is bright and even, highlighting the matte black and vibrant red packaging of the snacks. (3) A sequence follows showing close-up, high-angle shots of various snacks being poured into white bowls and plates: golden-brown caramel popcorn, red-tinted 'Salt Caramel Corn' rice crackers, and small, round brown 'Hojicha Latte Gummy' chocolates. The background transitions to show a 7-Eleven store promotional display. (4) The scene shifts to a retail setting inside a 7-Eleven store, featuring a large circular display stand packed with Netflix-themed snacks, popcorn buckets, and red Daruma dolls. Red and white lanterns are suspended from the ceiling, creating a bright, festive atmosphere. (5) Finally, the video shows two young women with long dark hair sitting at a table in a home setting. They are seen eating the snacks directly from the bags while looking toward the camera and talking, conveying a casual, social, and enjoyable snacking experience.

The BGM maintains a steady energy level and tempo without any structural pauses, providing a continuous, high-arousal foundation for the commentary. The audio remains focused entirely on the narration and the driving electronic beat, with no audible environmental noise or background store chatter, resulting in an excellent signal-to-noise ratio.
